SESSION_ID.description: Required WhatsApp session string. Supports the current GURU~ format and compatible older formats.

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Required owner WhatsApp number in international format.

BOT_MODE.description: Default bot access mode when no saved setting exists: public, private, group, or inbox.

DEFAULT_ANTILINK_MODE.description: Default group anti-link mode: off, delete, warn, or kick.

DEFAULT_ANTIBOT_MODE.description: Default group anti-bot mode: off, warn, or remove.

DEFAULT_ANTIPROMO_MODE.description: Default group anti-promotion mode: off, delete, warn, or kick.

ADMIN_NOTICE_ENABLED.description: Post a 'make me admin' notice when group security cannot act. Disabled by default; when enabled it is rate limited to one notice per chat per cooldown.

ADMIN_NOTICE_COOLDOWN_MS.description: Minimum gap in milliseconds between two 'make me admin' notices in the same chat. Defaults to 21600000 (6 hours).
